title: watchDeploymentActivities
responsibility: Polls host-wide deployment jobs, rejects stale replies and returns a cleanup function.

inputs.name: watchDeploymentActivities.workspace
inputs.description: Current project, revision, bridge capabilities and shared deployment stores shown by the app.

inputs.name: watchDeploymentActivities.events
inputs.description: Versioned callbacks that receive fresh jobs or a recoverable status-read failure.

outputs.name: watchDeploymentActivities
outputs.description: Cleanup callback that stops polling and discards later replies.
